incidents.desc: Car # 20 moves from the middle lane into the inside lane with plenty of space between him and the #9 car.  The #9 car fails to slow down and makes contact with the #20 car spinning and pushing the #20 car off the track.
incidents.ruling: #9 is at fault, if another car gets in front of you with plenty of space you need to respect their position on the track.  A mind punt is a good tool to use in this situation.

incidents.desc: The #12 car gets ready to enter the first chicane, the #9 attempts to straight line it into the corner and makes contact with the #12 causing him to spin.  The #92 taps the #9 as a follow up incident
The #26 car slows to enter the 1st chicane and the #17 car fails to slow in time making contact and spinning the #26
incidents.ruling: The #17 car is at fault remember cars in front of you will always check up in a corner.
